# The Great Commission (Matthew 28:19)

## Emotional Focus
Jesus sends us to tell others about His love.

## Key KJV
“Go ye therefore, and teach all nations.” (Matthew 28:19)

## Gentle Retelling
Before He went to heaven Jesus told His friends to go and tell everyone about Him. He is with us as we go.

## Coloring Prompt
Jesus standing with open arms while friends walk in different directions with happy faces.

## Read-along flow + response
“We can tell others that Jesus loves them.”
